name: plugpup-tarot
description: Get a real tarot reading in chat. The full 78-card deck is truly shuffled, reversed cards included, and dealt face down so you turn each card over yourself. Choose card of the day, a yes/no answer, past-present-future, a love reading, situation-challenge-advice or the 10-card Celtic Cross. Every card shows its position, meaning and keywords, and you can ask what any card means, upright or reversed. Copy your reading or draw again in one tap. For reflection and entertainment.
